description: A set of historical road network reconstruction transportation intersection data. A set of historical road network reconstruction transportation intersection data. is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Lin Wang, Yongze Song (Huaqiao University). This dataset was constructed to support the validation of the historical road network reconstruction model (PTN) and contains spatial information on key historical transportation intersections within Minnan region, Fujian Province. The data are primarily used to evaluate the deviation between the predicted ancient road network from the proposed model and actual historical transportation intersections. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 63196 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
